name: Riley
goal: Riley wants to find a restaurant that will not only serve delicious and unique food but also provide an energetic and memorable experience for him and his friends to celebrate his special night.
backstory: Riley has been looking forward to celebrating his birthday all week and is craving something more exciting than his usual go-to restaurant, which serves great burgers but lacks a lively atmosphere. He's been in the mood for trying new flavors, especially after hearing about a trendy fusion place that just opened up downtown. However, he's also a bit concerned that some of his friends might not be adventurous enough to try something completely different.

beliefs.concession: if friends are open to trying new food

name: Jordan
goal: Jordan wants to suggest a restaurant that is both novel and reliable, where everyone can find something to their taste without breaking the bank or risking a disappointing meal.
backstory: Jordan has been trying to cut back on spicy food after a bad experience at a Thai restaurant last month, often finds themselves thinking about unique dining settings, and tends to research restaurants thoroughly before visiting. They have a soft spot for waterfront eateries and usually checks the menu beforehand to ensure there are options they'll enjoy. Jordan's friends often joke that they're overly cautious when it comes to trying new cuisines.

beliefs.concession: if menu is thoroughly checked beforehand

name: Drew
goal: Drew wants to contribute his local knowledge to help the group choose a restaurant that will satisfy everyone's cravings and provide a lively atmosphere for conversation.
backstory: Drew has lived in the city for five years, developing a taste for craft breweries and often meeting friends at The Taproom on Fridays. However, after a disappointing experience with slow service at Bistro Bliss last month, Drew is wary of trendy restaurants that might prioritize style over substance. They usually rely on word-of-mouth recommendations to find hidden gems.

beliefs.concession: if everyone agrees to make a reservation
